title.narrative: Relief Food Assistance to Refugees and other Crisis Affected Populations

description.narrative:
The expected contribution will be programmed for a disbursement of unrestricted cash assistance to meet the food needs of 185,581 refugees (both urban- and settlement-based) for one month . The remaining budget will be used to cover associated costs for the provision of specialized nutritious foods to 152,612 children and pregnant and lactating women for one and a half months.
Given Uganda's evolving food security situation, allocating the remaining resources will be based on assessed vulnerabilities and resource gaps will ensure that WFP uses the Norwegian contribution in the most efficient manner, putting resources where they are most needed.
